name: hass-mcp
post_parameters: sh -c export HA_TOKEN=$(cat /run/secrets/tok); exec supergateway --stdio python -m app --port 8094
description: Home Assistant MCP server, bridged over HTTP with supergateway (baked into the image, on a current Node.js so supergateway's MCP SDK actually works) so any MCP client that speaks HTTP/SSE can use it.

paths.name: hass-token
paths.description: Read-only bind mount to a file containing your Home Assistant long-lived access token (never put the token directly in a Variable).

ports.name: Host Port 8094
ports.description: HTTP port supergateway serves the bridged MCP endpoint on.
